item.title: Verkehrsminister Bilger So will er die Deutsche Bahn sanieren
item.author: WiWo+
item.description: Es stimmt, dass die vielen Baustellen erst einmal zu Verspätungen führen, bevor es besser wird. Aber: Wir erreichen jetzt eine Phase, in der viele Baumaßnahmen abgeschlossen werden. Zehn Milliarden Euro investieren wir zudem allein in die Digitalisierung der Schiene. Damit können Effizienzgewinne erzielt werden, ohne neue Gleise zu verlegen. Unser Ziel bleibt klar: Deutschlands Züge müssen spürbar schneller ankommen.

item.title: Nagel Says He Can’t Exclude That ECB May Need to Hike Again
item.author: Bloomberg News (English)
item.description: (Bloomberg) -- The European Central Bank might have to raise borrowing costs again, according to Bundesbank President Joachim Nagel. “We’ve raised key interest rates twice,” he told reporters in Bangkok, where he’s attending the IMF annual meeting. “If the situation remains as it is, we don’t rule out the possibility that we may have to take further action.”

item.title: Nvidia Partner GMI Cloud Calls CoreWeave’s 15% Yield ‘Insane’
item.author: Bloomberg News (English)
item.description: The founder of a cloud computing company with a similar business model to CoreWeave Inc. said the 15% yield on the latter’s bonds is “insane,” compared with the roughly 3.45% rate his company secured on a recent Taiwan dollar loan. “This is an advantage,” GMI Cloud Chief Executive Officer Alex Yeh said in an interview on Thursday.

item.title: ECB’s Rehn Praises Measured Approach, Sees More Data in December
item.author: Bloomberg News (English)
item.description: European Central Bank Governing Council member Olli Rehn said policymakers will have additional information at the final rate decision of the year, while suggesting the current policy approach is working. In December “we will have our broad macroeconomic projection exercise on our table to look at and analyze in depth the European economy,” Rehn said in a Bloomberg Television interview on Friday.
